onhit_protocol:
(disassembly, this script's comments): 0 = not handled, 1 = handled, 2 = stop the
surrounding Sequence. Sequence 0x0801900B: runs children until one returns 2, result = AND of the results;
Selector 0x08018FDB: first non-zero child result; ApplyDamage 0x080187A5: hit mult 0 -> 0, else damage
(vfunc +0x58) -> 2 if it killed the enemy else 1.

onhit_fns.0x803123b: HoverDrift: impulse along the hit dir, 1
onhit_fns.0x803c08d: GlideToWaypoint: 1 if the player swings (anim slot 0x13) else 2

0x8029a41.name: IfAttack
0x8029a41.sem: hit attack type byte0 or byte1 == atk -> child

0x80187a5.name: ApplyDamage
0x80187a5.sem: hit mult 0 -> 0; else take damage: 2 if it killed the enemy, else 1

0x803999d.name: JanembaPartFlash
0x803999d.sem: Janemba body: flash the linked part (cosmetic); 0

0x803044d.name: FreezeHelperHit
0x803044d.sem: freeze helper 0x0E: message 5 to the world, 1

0x802d329.name: ShieldHit
0x802d329.sem: shield soldier: turn around / shield graphics (cosmetic), 1

0x8032f85.name: TankDamage
0x8032f85.sem: tank armour: hit mult 0 -> 0; obj+0x290 = hit dir; damage / 4 when the hit dir == facing; then as ApplyDamage

0x8018e5f.name: PopState
0x8018e5f.sem: pop the AI stack (vfunc +0x70); onHit pops and returns 2

0x80299c5.name: StunHold
0x80299c5.sem: hold controller 0x03002FF0 (stunned, no movement) - Burning Attack stun

0x8039bfd.name: ShockStun
0x8039bfd.sem: electric shock stun (Electric Kamehameha reaction) until the anim ends

0x803c8bf.name: VolleyballTransform
0x803c8bf.sem: turn into a volleyball (Ultra Volleyball Attack)

0x803c7ff.name: VolleyballRestore
0x803c7ff.sem: turn back from a volleyball; launched=1 when it was punched (flies, hits other enemies with melee 0x086B8098)

0x803c72f.name: VolleyballLaunch
0x803c72f.sem: the ball was punched: fly along the hit direction

0x8034aa5.name: PlayAnimTimed
0x8034aa5.sem: anims 20 then 18, controller 0x03003234 ends at frame 36 [INFERRED]

0x8036329.name: IfMeleeHit
0x8036329.sem: melee hit (0x086B8098) in front -> child (variant of 0x08036303) [INFERRED]

0x803ce71.name: IfUnknown
0x803ce71.sem: condition 0x0804EE25 not decoded: treated as false [INFERRED]
